rationale: The revision deletes the protected scope hedge “in this sample,” changes “may support” to the stronger assertion “supports,” and drops the required “preliminary” status of the moderation analysis. It also strengthens “consistent with the possibility that students with less developed prior knowledge may benefit more” to “The benefit ... was largest” and “therefore appears most valuable.” The replication qualifier remains in paraphrased form: “warrants replication ... before it is treated as general.” These strength changes were not authorized by R-1 or R-2 and include three explicitly forbidden moves.
